message: Hi, I'm a student with a machine learning certification background. My overall academic average is 80.4% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in cloud computing and security. I want to become a Web Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 29600 per year. I live in Coimbatore. I'm open to going abroad.

other_constraints: Interested in cloud computing and security

explanation:
This MTech in Computer Networks in Canada aligns well with your interest in cloud and networking. The tuition ($23650) is within budget, the minimum grade (73%) is achievable given your 80.4% average, and it offers a strong post-study work visa opportunity.

This MSc Cloud Computing in Canada provides excellent exposure to cybersecurity and networking while keeping tuition ($21500) within your financial limit. It also offers a significant post-study work visa of 36 months.

This MSc Software Engineering in Canada is highly relevant to your goal of becoming a Web Developer. The tuition ($10800) is very affordable and the program requires a CS background, matching your qualifications.

Located in Canada, this MTech Computer Networks offers relevant fields (networking/software) at a moderate tuition ($15650). While it doesn't require a CS background, its Canadian location and work visa potential make it a solid option.

This MSc Cloud Computing in Germany is the most budget-friendly international option ($1950 tuition) and directly covers cloud/networking. It requires a CS background and offers an 18-month post-study work visa.
